public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{

public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())

    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();

  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{

  }

  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {

    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

  }

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

  }

  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }

public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}

    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {

  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

public void activate()
{
  if (getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    setIsActive(true);
  }
  else
  {
    setIsActive(false);
  }
}
public void deactivate()
{
  setIsActive(false);
}
public double calculateAcceleration()
{
  if (isIsActive() && getFuelMass() > 0)
  {
    return getThrust() / getFuelMass();
  }
  return 0.0;
}
public double consumeFuel(final double time)
{
  double fuelConsumed = getThrust() * time / (getSpecificImpulse() * getG());
  if (getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed < 0)
  {
    double actualConsumed = getFuelMass();
    setFuelMass(0);
    setIsActive(false);
    return actualConsumed;
  }
  else
  {
    setFuelMass(getFuelMass() - fuelConsumed);
    return fuelConsumed;
  }
}
public void simulate(final int duration)
{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}

{
  if (isIsActive())
  {
    double acceleration = calculateAcceleration();
  }
  consumeFuel(duration);
  if (getFuelMass() == 0)
  {
    deactivate();
  }
}
